## Checklist

- [ ] Prices link to the official pricing page (`sourceUrl`) and `lastVerified` is today's date
- [ ] Trade-offs are listed honestly, not just the benefits
- [ ] Setup steps make sense to a non-technical person
- [ ] No affiliate links, logos or copied branding
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
